---
title: "Mapping Transit Proximity in Waterloo Region"
---

```{r echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}


library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)

library(osmdata)
library(osmextract)
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(htmltools)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(units)
library(lwgeom)
library(scales)

Census_data <- read_sf("data/data_raw/ldb_000b21a_e/ldb_000b21a_e.shp")

ION_stops <- read_sf("data/data_raw/ION_Stops/ION_Stops.shp") %>% 
  st_transform(st_crs(Census_data))

ION_routes <- read_sf("data/data_raw/ION_Routes/ION_Routes.shp") %>% 
    st_transform(st_crs(Census_data))

GRT_stops <- read_sf("data/data_raw/GRT_Stops/GRT_Stops.shp") %>% 
  st_transform(st_crs(Census_data))

bouding_box <- read_sf("data/data_raw/Regional_Boundary/Regional_Boundary.shp") %>% 
  st_transform(st_crs(Census_data))

Census_area <- Census_data[st_within(Census_data$geometry, bouding_box, sparse = FALSE), ]

Census_centroid <- Census_area %>%   st_centroid()

distance_matrix_ION <- st_distance(Census_centroid, ION_stops)


Census_centroid <- Census_centroid %>% 
  mutate(
    nearest_ION_idx  = apply(distance_matrix_ION, 1, which.min),
    dist_to_ION_city = apply(distance_matrix_ION, 1, min) / 1000,
    nearest_ION_name = ION_stops$StopName[nearest_ION_idx]
  )

# Sys.setenv(CANCENSUS_API_KEY = "CensusMapper_164474c9705b09054f031a9bff098515")
 source("analysis_files/ontario_db_demographics.R")

#load("ontario_db_demographics_2021.rds")

Census_area <- Census_area %>% 
  left_join(
    Census_centroid %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(DBUID, nearest_ION_name, dist_to_ION_city, nearest_ION_idx),
    by = "DBUID"
  )

Census_area <- Census_area %>% 
  left_join(ontario_db, by = c("DBUID" = "GeoUID"))


Census_area <- Census_area %>% 
    mutate(Denisty = Population/`Area (sq km)`)

```

Census_area <- Census_area %>%
  mutate(
    popup_base = paste0(
      "<b>NAME TEST:</b> ", DBUID, "<br>"
      
    ),

    popup_ION = paste0(
      popup_base,
      "<hr>",
      "<strong> Nearest ION Stop</strong><br>",
      nearest_ION_name, "<br>",
      "<strong> Nearest ION Distance</strong><br>",
      dist_to_ION_city, "km"
     ),

    popup_demo = paste0(
      popup_base,
      "<hr>",
      "<strong>👥 Demographics</strong><br>",
      "Population Denisty: ", Denisty, "<br>",
      "Dwellings: ", Dwellings
      
    )
  )



pal_ion <- colorFactor(
  palette = rev(c("#E8F5F0", "#C2E8DC", "#9ADBC7", "#6DCBAF", "#3EBB96", "#00A87A", "#00925E", "#007A4A",
  "#006038", "#004D2C")),
  domain = Census_area$dist_to_ION_city
)


pal_dens <- colorFactor(
  palette = rev(c("#E8F5F0", "#C2E8DC", "#9ADBC7", "#6DCBAF", "#3EBB96", "#00A87A", "#00925E", "#007A4A",
  "#006038", "#004D2C")),
  domain = Census_area$Denisty
)

ION_colour <- colorFactor(palette = c("orange", "white"),
                          domain = ION_stops$Stage1)

# pal_bike <- colorFactor(
#   domain = bike_lanes_mtl$cycleway,
#   palette = c("green", "blue", "orange", "red", "white")
# )
Census_area <- st_transform(Census_area, crs = 4326)
ION_stops <- st_transform(ION_stops, crs = 4326)
ION_routes <- st_transform(ION_routes, crs = 4326)
  
leaflet(Census_area) |>
addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
    addFullscreenControl() |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal_ion(dist_to_ION_city),
    color = "black",
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    # label = ~paste(`Canadidate and Party`),
     popupOptions = popupOptions(closeOnClick = FALSE),
     options = pathOptions(
       popup_base = Census_area$popup_base,
       popup_ION = Census_area$popup_ION,
       popup_demo = Census_area$popup_demo
    ),
    group = "ION Stops"
  ) |>
    addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal_dens(Denisty),
    color = "black",
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    # label = ~paste(`Canadidate and Party`),
     popupOptions = popupOptions(closeOnClick = FALSE),
     options = pathOptions(
       popup_base = Census_area$popup_base,
       popup_ION = Census_area$popup_ION,
       popup_demo = Census_area$popup_demo
    ),
    group = "Demographics"
  ) |>
     addPolylines(
    data = ION_routes,
    color = ~ION_colour(Stage1),
    weight = 2,
    opacity = 0.9,
    group = c("ION Stops", "Demographics")
  ) |>
    addCircleMarkers(
    data = ION_stops,
    
     color = ~ION_colour(Stage1),
    # #label = ~paste(cycleway),
     weight = 1,
    # opacity = 0.9,
    group = c("ION Stops", "Demographics")
  )  |> 
   addLayersControl(
     overlayGroups = c("ION Stops", "Demographics"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>% 
  #  hideGroup(c(
  #   "Bike Lanes"
  # )) %>% 
  onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      var map = this;

      function updatePopups(mode) {
        map.eachLayer(function(layer) {
          if (layer.options && layer.options.popup_base) {
            var html;
            if (mode === 'Ion') {
              html = layer.options.popup_ION;
            } else if (mode === 'demo') {
              html = layer.options.popup_demo;
            } else {
              html = layer.options.popup_base;
            }
            layer.bindPopup(html, { closeOnClick: false });
          }
        });
      }

      map.on('overlayadd', function(e) {
        if (e.name === 'ION Stops') {
          updatePopups('Ion');
        }
        if (e.name === 'Demographics') {
          updatePopups('demo');
        }
      });

      map.on('overlayremove', function(e) {
        updatePopups('base');
      });

      updatePopups('base');
    }
  ")
